prompt_template.description: Extract [head entity, verb, tail entity] triples from CoNLL-U dependency tree
prompt_template.system: You extract subject-verb-object triples from CoNLL-U. Output only lines: head | verb | tail
prompt_template.human:
CoNLL-U tree:
{tree}

Extract every subject–verb–object triple:
- head = nsubj dependent phrase of the verb
- verb = main verb (lemma or surface)
- tail = obj/iobj/obl dependent phrase

Output one triple per line, pipe-separated:
head | verb | tail

No explanation. If none, output: NONE
